business_problem: JTB was managing support and project work through fragmented processes across more than 100 group companies, which slowed approvals and reduced the time teams could spend on customer engagement.
solution_summary: JTB was managing support and project work through fragmented processes across more than 100 group companies, which slowed approvals and reduced the time teams could spend on customer engagement. JTB implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, and Now Assist. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; IT Service Management standardizes incidents and requests; Strategic Portfolio Management connects demand, capacity, and priorities; Now Assist adds generative search, summarization, and drafting. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by Now Assist before ServiceNow AI Platform, IT Service Management, and Strategic Portfolio Management routes or fulfills the work. The same record of work is then exposed back to agents and end users through the platform.
